definitions.explanation: To pull something to make it longer or larger.
To make a photograph larger, to print an enlargement.
To stretch out the time of something, to drag out a process.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゴム→ゴム：00073_gomu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{伸|の}ばす。
⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{薄|うす}く→薄い：00764_usui⟧{引|ひ}き{伸|の}ばす。

notes:
COMPOUND VERB: ⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ (to pull) + ⟦{伸|の}ばす→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧ (to extend) = to pull and extend

TRANSITIVITY: Transitive. The intransitive counterpart is ⟦{引|ひ}き{伸|の}びる→引き伸びる：noentry⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{伸|の}ばす (to enlarge a photo)
- ⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{伸|の}ばす (to extend the period)
- ⟦{決定|けってい}→決定：02701_kettei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{伸|の}ばす (to delay a decision)
- {引|ひ}き{伸|の}ばし (noun form: enlargement; delay)

PHOTOGRAPHY USAGE: In the context of film photography, {引|ひ}き{伸|の}ばす refers to making an enlargement print from a negative.

RELATED ～{伸|の}ばす COMPOUND VERBS:
- ⟦{書|か}き{伸|の}ばす→書き伸ばす：noentry⟧ - to extend in writing
- ⟦{押|お}し{伸|の}ばす→押し伸ばす：noentry⟧ - to spread by pressing
